<?php

$maxS = $s;
$maxP = $p;

// Precompute factorials and inverse factorials
$fact = array_fill(0, $maxS + $maxP + 5, 1);
$invFact = array_fill(0, $maxS + $maxP + 5, 1);

for ($i = 1; $i < count($fact); $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = ($fact[$i - 1] * $i) % MOD;
}

// fast power
function modPow($a, $e) {
    $res = 1;
    $a %= MOD;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $a) % MOD;
        $a = ($a * $a) % MOD;
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

// inverse factorials
$invFact[count($fact) - 1] = modPow($fact[count($fact) - 1], MOD - 2);
for ($i = count($fact) - 2; $i >= 0; $i--) {
    $invFact[$i] = ($invFact[$i + 1] * ($i + 1)) % MOD;
}

function comb($n, $k, $fact, $invFact) {
    if ($k < 0 || $k > $n) return 0;
    return ($fact[$n] * $invFact[$k] % MOD) * $invFact[$n - $k] % MOD;
}

// number of ways for given x: C((s-r-x)+p-2, p-2)
$totalStates = 0;
$maxX = $s - $r;
for ($x = 0; $x <= $maxX; $x++) {
    $rem = $s - $r - $x;
    $totalStates = ($totalStates + comb($rem + $p - 2, $p - 2, $fact, $invFact)) % MOD;
}

// winning states
$winStates = 0;

// iterate Hasan's score a1
for ($a1 = $r; $a1 <= $s; $a1++) {
    $rem = $s - $a1;
    if ($rem < 0) break;

    // max score any other player can have is at most a1
    // we consider maximum score among others = m, where 0<=m<=a1
    // Hasan wins with probability 1/(k+1) if exactly k other players have score a1 and no one exceeds a1
    // We count states grouped by k (number of others with score a1)
    for ($k = 0; $k <= $p - 1; $k++) {
        // choose k players among p-1 to have score a1
        $chooseK = comb($p - 1, $k, $fact, $invFact);

        // remaining players: p-1-k, total remaining goals: rem - k*a1
        $remGoals = $rem - $k * $a1;
        if ($remGoals < 0) break;

        // each of these remaining players must have score <= a1-1
        // number of nonnegative integer solutions b_i <= a1-1, sum = remGoals
        // use inclusion-exclusion on upper bound
        $ways = 0;
        $n = $p - 1 - $k;
        for ($t = 0; $t <= $n; $t++) {

            }

        $invK1 = modPow($k + 1, MOD - 2);
        $add = $ways * $chooseK % MOD * $invK1 % MOD;
        $winStates = ($winStates + $add) % MOD;
    }

const MOD = 998244353;

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d %d", $p, $s, $r);

$maxN = $s + $p + 5;
$fact = array_fill(0, $maxN, 1);
$invFact = array_fill(0, $maxN, 1);

for ($i = 1; $i < $maxN; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = ($fact[$i - 1] * $i) % MOD;
}

function modPow($a, $e) {
    $res = 1;
    $a %= MOD;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $a) % MOD;
        $a = ($a * $a) % MOD;
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

$invFact[$maxN - 1] = modPow($fact[$maxN - 1], MOD - 2);
for ($i = $maxN - 2; $i >= 0; $i--) {
    $invFact[$i] = ($invFact[$i + 1] * ($i + 1)) % MOD;
}

function comb($n, $k, $fact, $invFact) {
    if ($k < 0 || $k > $n) return 0;
    return ($fact[$n] * $invFact[$k] % MOD) * $invFact[$n - $k] % MOD;
}

// Total number of states: a1 >= r, ai >= 0, sum = s
// Let x1 = a1 - r >= 0, sum of others unchanged
// x1 + a2 + ... + ap = s - r  with all >= 0
$remain = $s - $r;
if ($remain < 0) {
    echo "0\n";
    exit;
}
$totalStates = comb($remain + $p - 1, $p - 1, $fact, $invFact);

// Count winning states
$winStates = 0;

// Iterate over Hasan's actual score a1
for ($a1 = $r; $a1 <= $s; $a1++) {
    $rest = $s - $a1;
    if ($rest < 0) break;

    // For given a1, count configurations of other players and probability Hasan wins
    // We need to consider number of players tying with Hasan.
    // Let t be number of other players with score exactly a1.
    // For fixed t, remaining p-1-t players have scores in [0, a1-1].
    // We count number of ways to distribute rest among p-1 players with these constraints.

    $waysForA1 = 0;
    $probForA1 = 0;

    // Precompute distributions with upper bound using inclusion-exclusion:
    // count of (b1..bn) with 0<=bi<=a1 and sum=rest
    // n = p-1
    $n = $p - 1;
    if ($n == 0) {
        // Only Hasan
        $waysForA1 = 1;
        $probForA1 = 1;
    } else {
        // We'll iterate t (number of players with score exactly a1)
        // For each t, count ways where exactly t players have score a1.
        for ($t = 0; $t <= $n; $t++) {
            $sumOthers = $rest - $t * $a1;
            if ($sumOthers < 0) break;

            // Choose which t players have score a1
            $chooseT = comb($n, $t, $fact, $invFact);

            // Remaining m = n - t players have scores in [0, a1-1], sum = sumOthers
            $m = $n - $t;
            if ($m == 0) {
                if ($sumOthers == 0) {
                    $ways = $chooseT;
                } else {
                    $ways = 0;
                }
            } else {
                // Count number of solutions with upper bound a1-1 using inclusion-exclusion
                // 0 <= bi <= a1-1, sum = sumOthers
                // Transform ci = bi, standard bounded composition:
                // count = sum_{k=0..m} (-1)^k * C(m, k) * C(sumOthers - k*(a1) + m -1, m -1)
                $waysBounded = 0;
                for ($k = 0; $k <= $m; $k++) {
                    $val = $sumOthers - $k * $a1;
                    if ($val < 0) break;
                    $add = comb($m, $k, $fact, $invFact) * comb($val + $m - 1, $m - 1, $fact, $invFact) % MOD;
                    if ($k % 2 == 1) {
                        $waysBounded = ($waysBounded - $add + MOD) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        $waysBounded = ($waysBounded + $add) % MOD;
                    }
                }
                $ways = $chooseT * $waysBounded % MOD;
            }

            if ($ways == 0) continue;

            $waysForA1 = ($waysForA1 + $ways) % MOD;

            // Probability Hasan wins given this tie count t:
            // If t = 0, Hasan strictly wins: prob = 1
            // If t > 0, Hasan wins with probability 1/(t+1)
            $probWinGivenT = ($t == 0) ? 1 : modPow($t + 1, MOD - 2);
            $probForA1 = ($probForA1 + $ways * $probWinGivenT) % MOD;
        }
    }

    // Add to total winning states
    $winStates = ($winStates + $probForA1) % MOD;
}

// Probability = winStates / totalStates
if ($totalStates == 0) {
    echo "0\n";
    exit;
}
$invTotal = modPow($totalStates, MOD - 2);
$ans = $winStates * $invTotal % MOD;
echo $ans . "\n";

Once again, Hasan doesn't know the exact scores (he doesn't know his exact score as well).
